end.parentNote: Asha practised farm-animal names, animal sounds, rhymes, and the pattern “The ___ says ___.” Krish named the animals and made a new sentence; some sound words were mixed up, and “cock-a-doodle-doo” and “moo” were revisited later. Krish said they were safe and asked to play a game; please check in gently and offer a calm, listening space. At home, use animal pictures to practise one sound at a time and clap the beats in “moo/coo/doo” and “cluck/duck.”
